self_company.description: Metro-map-style database-visualization node/edge graph tool. Angular 17 + SignalDB (reactive local-first); vision: every component becomes JSON (live-editable data-defined UI). Wedge: best-of-both AI+UI, low surface area, no agent-vs-graph-chat confusion.
